items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: That's the name of Paul Gaithin made it and called it True.

ctx.x: I don't have hardly any of them. At one time I had three or four of them. I don't have maybe one or two now around. I wish I'd saved all of them. I've lost a couple of them.

I made Duke Ellington's Ringin' Bells. Oh yeah, I remember that. And I put that on. And I'll tell you about those recordings. Then I was the first one made this number, You Don't Love Me. You see the right name wasn't You Don't Love Me. That's the name of Paul Gaithin made it and called it True.
